messages:
mira: Heads up — hit a weird ESM/CJS entrypoint bug when running our JS SDK under Cloudflare Workers. Auth retries end up double-sending the auth header sometimes. Repro in sampleapp-edge with wrangler. Anyone seen this?

kevin: hmm. double-send as in duplicate Authorization header or two separate requests? any minimal repro?

mira: duplicate Authorization header on the same outgoing request. Minimal repro: change package.json to "type": "module" and import the SDK via an entrypoint that still uses a cjs shim. Wrangler + esbuild rolls an import that triggers both esm and cjs conditional code paths.

mira: snippet:```json
// package.json
{
  "name": "sampleapp-edge",
  "type": "module",
  "exports": {"./runtime": {"import": "./dist/runtime.mjs", "require": "./dist/runtime.cjs"}},
  "dependencies": {"@redwood-inference/sdk": "^0.1.0"}
}
```

mira: and worker entry:```js
import { RedwoodClient } from './runtime';
addEventListener('fetch', e => e.respondWith(handle(e.request)));
async function handle(req){
  const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: GLOBAL_API_KEY });
  return c.generate('hello');
}
```

angel: ugh that smells like our auth middleware being registered twice depending on which export slot bundler picks. CF Workers bundlers sometimes include both import AND require builds if conditional exports are present and bundler can't statically decide.

kevin: can you paste the HTTP debug? deploy-bot usually logs outgoing headers for us in dev.

deploy-bot: [log] outgoing request POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate headers: Authorization: Bearer xxx, Authorization: Bearer xxx, Content-Type: application/json

mira: exactly. The SDK's retry wrapper attaches Authorization if missing, but an ESM initializer path already injected it (we call getAuthHeader twice because both modules run some init). When bundler inlines both runtime.cjs and runtime.mjs chunks the side-effect init runs twice.

angel: immediate fix: make init idempotent AND avoid side-effectful top-level auth attachment. Prefer lazy attach on request. Also we should add a tiny `if (globalThis.__redwood_init_done) return` guard.

kevin: long-term: update package exports to avoid ambiguous dual-inclusion under common bundlers. Also add a note in devex docs for CF Workers: "avoid conditional exports that include both require and import paths unless you know the bundler resolution".

mira: typing gotchas too — when we add conditional exports, TS sometimes picks the wrong .d.ts and editors show both overloads, causing confusion in sampleapps where people import via `require()`-style.

angel: proposal: add two small things: 1) example worker entry in sampleapp-edge using a single explicit esm bundle (dist/worker.mjs) + wrangler config, 2) a tiny shim in SDK that checks for CJS/ESM double-init and is a no-op if already initialized.

kevin: agree. Also throw a smoke test into CI that runs Miniflare against the built sampleapp-edge to catch this in PRs. We can assert only one Authorization header is sent.

mira: I'll open a PR with the init-guard + update sampleapp-edge and a devex note. Will add the Miniflare check as a follow-up if that's ok.

angel: please add a tiny README snippet about types: include an explicit `types` entry in `exports` and show how to import the SDK in workers: `import { RedwoodClient } from '.../dist/runtime.mjs'`. That reduces editor confusion.

ci-bot: CI run queued: sampleapp-edge/miniflare-smoke-test (optional).

kevin: thanks @mira — tag me on the PR, I'll review the init guard + docs. :thumbsup:

mira: will do. Thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
